title: ingest: Soroban fee accessors and ledger.SorobanFeeWrite1Kb return (0, false) for protocol 23+ meta (only TransactionMeta v3 / LedgerCloseMeta v1 are read)

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: SorobanTotalNonRefundableResourceFeeCharged, SorobanTotalRefundableResourceFeeCharged and SorobanRentFeeCharged read only TransactionMeta v3 and SorobanFeeWrite1Kb only LedgerCloseMeta v1, so on every protocol 23+ ledger they return (0, false), which reads as 'does not apply': a silent wrong result for every current Soroban transaction. On v3 meta they also panic for a missing sorobanMeta or ext v0. The issue finds no caller in go-stellar-sdk, Horizon or stellar-rpc; affected code is third-party code that calls the helpers.

entries.expected: the Soroban fee accessors and SorobanFeeWrite1Kb return the values in TransactionMeta v4 sorobanMeta.ext.v1 and LedgerCloseMeta v2 ext.v1
entries.observed: No conformance fact of the kit calls these helpers. By hand on v0.9.0 on pubnet ledger 65437014 (protocol 29, LedgerCloseMeta v2): SorobanFeeWrite1Kb gives (0, false) where the header extension holds 1000, and the three accessors give (0, false) for transaction 07c5d869… whose meta holds 6690, 76 and 56.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's program on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255, on pubnet ledger 65437014 from the public data lake: SorobanFeeWrite1Kb(lcm) = (0, false), SorobanTotalNonRefundableResourceFeeCharged() = (0, false), SorobanTotalRefundableResourceFeeCharged() = (0, false), SorobanRentFeeCharged() = (0, false); on v3 meta, panics for sorobanMeta.ext v0 and for a classic transaction. In 1,500 pubnet ledgers from protocol 23 on, all 1,500 and all 176,055 Soroban transactions give (0, false).
evidence.expected_basis: From protocol 23 stellar-core writes TransactionMeta v4 and LedgerCloseMeta v2, which carry the same sorobanMeta.ext.v1 fee fields and ext.v1.sorobanFeeWrite1KB as v3 and v1; SorobanResourceFeeRefund and TotalByteSizeOfLiveSorobanState in the same package already read both.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: all four helpers return (0, false) on pubnet ledger 65437014.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6053; this record restates the public issue.
